professionalSummary.text: Candidate has extensive experience in releasing ranking models to the production search service under a traffic ramp and monitoring live dashboards for relevance and conversion metrics.
professionalSummary.witness: Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate has taken on-call duty for ranking incidents, including handling a feature store outage in autumn 2024.
